notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {R}
When Cult Conscript dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
